messages.snippet: Join us for a CPD lunchtime seminar on recent developments in SDLT and TOGC treatment for commercial
messages.subject: Lunchtime seminar: SDLT and TOGC on commercial property - 26 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Join us for a CPD lunchtime seminar on recent developments in SDLT and TOGC treatment for commercial property transactions, presented by the Tax group. Wednesday 26 March, 12:30-13:30, Boardroom 4 (sandwiches provided). Register via the L&D portal.

Learning & Development
